title: Research FLK and SGS source-policy profile applicability

body:
2026-10-05: Bounded follow-up from #402. No source-policy object should be added or corrected until the intended policy domain is demonstrated.

## Scope
Research the missing FLK and SGS entries in data/location-policy.json for #402 subjects FLK-5152 and atlas:coverage:SGS+00?. Inspect the policy schema, how source policy lookups bind country/reference codes to locations, the distinct ARG/GBR entries, the selected Natural Earth feature roles and source vintage/license, and the existing Europe-only source-policy correction overlay. Determine whether FLK and SGS warrant explicit profiles, what each profile is intended to describe (original selected layer versus effective role), and whether one or both locations should inherit ARG/GBR, have territory-specific profiles, or remain unprofiled. Preserve conflicting claims and uncertainty. Do not infer province tiers, legal sovereignty, completeness or source suitability from policy coverage. Do not modify canonical geography, policy runtime, correction bundle, or publication/import gates.

Acceptance: a reproducible source-policy schema/context audit with exact baseline hashes; independently sourced applicability conclusions for both subjects; a bounded implementation recommendation or explicit no-profile rationale; keep semantic and regional approval open. One PR maximum. Depends on #402 so it remains blocked until that evidence packet is accepted.
